resources.string: Allow other apps to broadcast one text-completion request. This does not grant tool access, but may use model quota.
Master switch. When off, every screen read/tap/input/multi-step tool refuses to run until you turn it back on.
Currently disabled: every screen read, tap, input and multi-step tool refuses to run until you turn the switch above back on.
Accessibility service is not connected (the system may have released it). Screen reading and tapping will fail.

Explicitly assign a task in chat first. During the allowed window, only allowlisted screen reading, taps, and scrolling can run automatically. Input, send, publish, pay, and delete actions still need approval.
Automation runs only when the time window, app, action, and daily limit all match.
One package per line. The default Xiaohongshu package is com.xingin.xhs.
Counted only after successful execution. Reaching the limit revokes the current task grant.
A time range alone never grants access. State the package and operation in chat, then confirm here. The grant is limited to that chat’s latest user message.
